content: 我想你们专门用一个专题了解现在的仓库git

args.command:
cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== REMOTES ===" && git remote -v && echo -e "
=== BRANCHES ===" && git branch -a -vv && echo -e "
=== TAGS ===" && git tag -l -n1 && echo -e "
=== STASH ===" && git stash list && echo -e "
=== STATUS ===" && git status --short | head -30 && echo -e "
=== HEAD ===" && git log --oneline -1 && echo -e "
=== .gitconfig ===" && cat .gitconfig 2>/dev/null || echo "no .gitconfig"
cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== COMMIT HISTORY (last 30) ===" && git log --all --oneline --graph --decorate -30 && echo -e "\n=== REFLOG (last 30) ===" && git reflog -30

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== HOOKS ===" && ls -la .git/hooks/ 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== GITIGNORE ===" && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null | head -30 && echo -e "
=== WORKTREES ===" && git worktree list 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== SUBMODULES ===" && cat .gitmodules 2>/dev/null || echo "no submodules" && echo -e "
=== DIR STRUCTURE (top) ===" && ls -la | head -30

commands: cd /root/nanobot-src && printf '=== REPO: nanobot-src ===\n'; pwd; echo '---BRANCHES---'; git branch -a -vv; echo '---TAGS---'; git tag -l; echo '---RECENT LOG---'; git log --oneline --date-order --all -30; echo '---STASH LIST---'; git stash list; echo '---REMOTE---'; git remote -v; echo ''; cd /root/.nanobot/workspace && printf '=== REPO: workspace ===\n'; pwd; echo '---BRANCHES---'; git branch -a -vv; echo '---TAGS---'; git tag -l; echo '---RECENT LOG---'; git log --oneline --date-order --all -30; echo '---STASH LIST---'; git stash list; echo '---REMOTE---'; git remote -v

args.command:
cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== TOTAL COMMITS ===" && git rev-list --all --count && echo -e "
=== FIRST COMMIT ===" && git log --all --reverse --oneline -1 && echo -e "
=== AUTHORS ===" && git log --all --format="%an" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn && echo -e "
=== COMMIT FREQUENCY (by date) ===" && git log --all --format="%ad" --date=short | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20 && echo -e "
=== ORPHAN BRANCHES (unreachable from HEAD) ===" && git branch -a --no-merged main 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== DANGLING COMMITS ===" && git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs 2>&1 | grep "commit" | head -10 && echo -e "
=== LARGEST FILES ===" && git ls-tree -r -l --all | sort -k4 -n -r | head -10

args.commands: ["cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== ORPHAN BRANCH (context-compression-fix) ==='; git log --oneline context-compression-fix -5 2>/dev/null || echo '(not found as branch)'; echo ''; echo '=== ALL REFS ==='; git show-ref --heads --tags 2>/dev/null; echo ''; echo '=== DIFF dev vs main ==='; git diff dev..main --stat; echo ''; echo '=== UNTRACKED FILES ==='; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | head -30; echo ''; echo '=== WORKSPACE REMOTE CONFIG ==='; cd /root/.nanobot/workspace && cat .git/config 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'remote|url']

args.command:
cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== STASH@{0} DIFF STATS ===" && git stash show stash@{0} --stat 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== STASH@{1} DIFF STATS ===" && git stash show stash@{1} --stat 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== STASH@{2} DIFF STATS ===" && git stash show stash@{2} --stat 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== CONTEXT COMPRESSION BRANCH (d52e6a6) ===" && git log --oneline 11c678c..d52e6a6 && echo -e "
=== FILES CHANGED IN CONTEXT COMPRESSION BRANCH ===" && git diff --stat 11c678c..d52e6a6

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== AUTO-SNAPSHOT PATTERN ===" && git log --all --oneline --grep="auto-snapshot" | wc -l && echo "auto-snapshot commits found" && echo -e "
=== SNAPSHOT PATTERN ===" && git log --all --oneline --grep="快照\|snapshot\|stable\|checkpoint" | head -20 && echo -e "
=== CHERRY-PICK PATTERN ===" && git log --all --oneline --grep="cherry-pick" | head -10 && echo -e "
=== COMMIT SIZE ANALYSIS ===" && git log --all --format="%h %s" | while read hash msg; do lines=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id -r "$hash" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$lines $hash $msg"; done | sort -rn | head -15

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== ORPHAN BRANCH CHECK ==='; git branch -a | grep -i compress; git log --oneline context-compression-fix -5 2>/dev/null || echo "(branch context-compression-fix not found locally)"; git log --oneline origin/context-compression-fix -5 2>/dev/null || echo "(no remote either)"
cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== FULL GRAPH WITH DECORATE ==='; git log --all --oneline --graph --decorate -60
cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== STASH CONTENTS SUMMARY ==='; for i in 0 1 2; do echo "--- stash@{$i} ---"; git stash show -p stash@{$i} 2>/dev/null | head -40; done

cd /root/.nanobot/workspace && echo '=== FILE TREE TOP LEVEL ==='; ls -la; echo ''; echo '=== SUBDIR COUNT ==='; find . -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort | head -40; echo ''; echo '=== TOTAL FILES ==='; git ls-files | wc -l; echo ''; echo '=== GITIGNORE ==='; cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== PROJECT STRUCTURE OVERVIEW ==='; du -sh */ 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -20; echo ''; echo '=== KEY DIRECTORIES ==='; ls -d nanobot/*/ 2>/dev/null; echo ''; echo '=== PACKAGE VERSION ==='; python3 -c "try: import nanobot; print(nanobot.__version__); except: print('no __version__')" 2>/dev/null; cat setup.cfg 2>/dev/null | grep -i version | head -3 || cat pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -i version | head -3

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== REPO SIZE ===" && du -sh .git && echo -e "
=== PACKED OBJECTS ===" && git count-objects -vH && echo -e "
=== VERSION TIMELINE ===" && git tag -l --sort=-creatordate --format='%(refname:short) %(creatordate:short) %(subject)' | head -25 && echo -e "
=== NANOBOT DIR STRUCTURE ===" && find nanobot -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort && echo -e "
=== GITIGNORE FULL ===" && cat .gitignore

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== RECENT ACTIVITY (May 2026) ===" && git log --all --oneline --format="%h %ai %an %s" --since="2026-05-01" && echo -e "\n=== APRIL 2026 ACTIVITY ===" && git log --all --oneline --format="%h %ai %an %s" --since="2026-04-01" --until="2026-05-01" | head -30 && echo -e "\n=== DELETED BRANCHES (reflog) ===" && git reflog --all | grep "checkout: moving from" | awk '{print $4}' | sort -u | grep -v "^main$\|^dev$\|^HEAD" | head -20

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== TAG TIMELINE ==='; for t in $(git tag --sort=-creatordate); do echo "$(git log -1 --format='%ci' $t)  $t"; done; echo ''; echo '=== DETACHED COMMITS OUTSIDE MAINLINE ==='; git log --all --oneline --left-right --boundary bb23ae3...$(git rev-list --all --not bb23ae3 | tr '\n' ' ') 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ''; echo '=== SILLYTAVERN SIZE ==='; du -sh SillyTavern/ 2>/dev/null; echo '=== CASE DIR ==='; ls case/ 2>/dev/null | head -10

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo '=== GROUPCHAT MODULE BREAKDOWN ==='; find nanobot/groupchat -type f -name '*.py' | sort; echo ''; echo '=== SETUP/PROJECT META ==='; cat setup.py 2>/dev/null || cat pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /root/nanobot-src && echo "=== DELETED BRANCHES (from reflog checkout patterns) ===" && git reflog --all | grep "checkout: moving from" | sed 's/.*checkout: moving from //' | sed 's/ to .*//' | sort -u | grep -v "^main$\|^dev$\|^HEAD$" && echo -e "
=== DANGLING COUNT ===" && git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs 2>&1 | grep -c "unreachable commit" && echo -e "
=== GIT CONFIG (local) ===" && git config --local --list 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== GIT CONFIG (global) ===" && git config --global --list 2>/dev/null && echo -e "
=== CORE MODULES (py files count) ===" && find nanobot -name "*.py" -not -path "*__pycache__*" | wc -l && echo -e "
=== TOTAL LINES OF CODE ===" && find nanobot -name "*.py" -not -path "*__pycache__*" -exec cat {} + | wc -l

cat > /root/.nanobot/workspace/memory/MEMORY.md << 'MEMEOF'
# Nanobot Git 仓库专题报告 (2026-05-11)

## 仓库概况
- 路径: /root/nanobot-src
- 总提交: 1650 | 代码行: 33,516 | Python文件: 112
- .git 大小: 62MB | 打包对象: 10,903
- 无远程仓库 (no remotes)
- 无子模块, 无 worktree, hooks 全部为 sample (未激活)

## 分支结构
- dev = main = bb23ae3 (当前 HEAD)
- 无真正分支开发流程, dev/main 始终同步
- 已删除分支: feat/groupchat-optimization, feat/groupchat-rollback, feature/langgraph-rewrite, fix/multimodal-session-bloat, fix/multimodal-tool-result-handling, wip/current-changes, backup-20260413-current, archive/pre-rollback-snapshot

## 版本时间线
- v0.1.3.post4 (02-04) → v0.1.4 (02-18) → v0.1.4.post8-stable (05-05) → v0.1.5-stable (05-08) → v-stable-20260511 (05-11)
- 稳定版标签: v0.1.4.post5-safe, v0.1.4.post6-stable, v0.1.4.post7-stable, v0.1.4.post8-stable, v0.1.5-stable, v-stable-20260511, stable-pre-config-change, stable/pre-history-settings-defaults-update

## Stash (3个)
- stash@{0}: WIP on dev: 312760b — 用户消息即时中断 busy agent (context.py + persistence.py, +32/-5)
- stash@{1}: WIP on main: 61a9ff5 — agent rank/model list corruption defense (engine.py, +7/-1)
- stash@{2}: On feat/groupchat-optimization — streaming fix + leader standby mode (2026-04-03, agent_runner.py, +15/-5)

## 孤立分支
- d52e6a6: context compression fix (3 commits, 未合入 HEAD, 修改 context.py/broadcast.py/callbacks.py)

## 提交模式问题
- 147 个 auto-snapshot 提交 (自动快照, 每5-30分钟一个)
- 419 个 dangling commits (不可达提交)
- 主要作者: Re-bin(677), nanobot(283), Xubin Ren(145), 外部贡献者(100+人)
- 高峰日: 2026-02-20(92次), 2026-03-16(67次)

## Git 配置
- local: user=nanobot@local, alias.rollback="reset --hard main"
- global: user=nanobot@server, safe.directory=*

## 项目结构
nanobot/{bus, channels/telegram, cli, config, cron, groupchat/{display,history,orchestra}, heartbeat, providers, security, session, skills/*, templates, tools, utils}
MEMEOF
echo "MEMORY.md written"
